title: Faulty bottles
text: Faulty bottles. 3 of the bottles have massive, nubby seams on the bottom of them. They don't stand upright, they just wobble around. You can't shave or clip the seam, it's melted plastic. So a quarter if the product was faulty. The remaining bottles are great. They mist evenly and the lid clicks on tight.

product_metadata.title: Rommeka Spray Bottles, 2.7oz/80ml Small Plastic Empty Spray Bottle, Reusable Liquid Containers Fine Mist Spray with 2pcs Funnels, Set of 12
features: Safety Material - These mini spray bottles are made of high quality plastic, BPA free. Available for filling most of liquid.
Portable - The travel spray bottle is small size allows you to take it everywhere, just put it into your bag or pocket. Portable for travel or household.
Easy to Use - The empty spray bottles come with 2pcs funnels, can help you to transfer your makeup in ease and reduce waste.
Leakproof - Each mist spray bottle includes a clear snap on over-cap to ensure the contents do not spill into your luggage or bag
Notice - Please don’t use this spray bottle to hold hot water, otherwise it will be warped and may burn you.
